messages:
zoe: Hi all  first day here! I downloaded the kubeconfig from the onboarding portal but `kubectl get pods -n data-tools` returns an auth error: 
```
Error from server (Unauthorized): Unauthorized
```
I did Okta SSO earlier though. Any quick checks? :wave:

pri: welcome @zoe! That Unauthorized usually means the token in your kubeconfig expired or the `exec` plugin isn't configured. Run `kubectl config view --raw` and look at the user section for `exec` or a `token:` field. Also `kubectl config current-context` to confirm you're using the right context.

zoe: current-context is `redwood-dev@redwood-cluster`. `kubectl config view --raw` shows an `exec` block but the command is `okta-oidc` and it errors if I run it manually: 
```
$ okta-oidc get-token
error: token expired, refresh required
```

okta-bot: Reminder: If your OIDC token expires you need to re-run the auth flow: `redwood-oidc login` or use the portal to re-generate. Tokens expire after 8h for interactive sessions.

dan: quick steps: 1) run `redwood-oidc login` (or click "Re-authenticate" in onboarding portal), 2) check `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n data-tools`, 3) if still `Unauthorized`, set `KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config` explicitly and retry. If you hit a proxy timeout, try the bastion SOCKS route.

zoe: ran `redwood-oidc login` and did the browser flow. Now `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n data-tools` returns `no` (not unauthorized) so token is ok but I don't have RBAC. I submitted an access request via the portal.

infra-bot: Access request #AK-18109 created for user zoe. Approver: @pri. Status: pending. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/AK-18109

pri: I can approve for onboarding. Do you need `view` or `edit` in `data-tools`? For quick dev work we usually grant `view` first and then a temporary `edit` for 48h if requested. Also DM me your GitHub handle so I can map the AD group.

zoe: view is fine for now. GitHub handle: zoecode. Thanks!

pri: approved AK-18109 for `view`. infra-bot will create a binding to `onboard-zoe` for 48h.

infra-bot: Access request AK-18109 updated: approved by pri. Temporary binding `onboard-zoe` -> namespace `data-tools` (role: view). Expires in 172800 seconds.

zoe: confirmed `kubectl get pods -n data-tools` works! One more thing: how do I avoid typing `-n data-tools` every time?

dan: set a context that bakes the namespace: 
```
kubectl config set-context zoe-data --namespace=data-tools --cluster=redwood-dev@redwood-cluster --user=zoecode
kubectl config use-context zoe-data
```
That makes `kubectl get pods` default to `data-tools`. Also, if you need to port-forward use `kubectl -n data-tools port-forward svc/dev-ui 8080:80` and keep the bastion SOCKS up if you're behind corp proxy.

zoe: awesome, context set and everything is working. Really appreciate the quick help :heart:
